taxon_match.method: Exact normalized BLM ScientificName to one Project Isitusa catalog binomial

geography_match.method: Exact provider State + STATE_FIPS + COUNTY_FIPS + FIPS agreement with one active county equivalent; no coordinate inference

spatial_scope: Positive cover at BLM AIM plot HELIPAD_DISTURBED in Anchorage Municipality, AK; not a complete inventory of the county or unsampled land.
caveats: This historical plot detection supports recorded presence only at a sampled BLM AIM location.
It does not establish current abundance, countywide distribution, or establishment beyond the retained plot observation.
Missing, zero-cover, unmatched, and rejected rows create no absence or non-detection claim.
notes: The preflight group represented 1 positive source record(s); the lowest stable OBJECTID was retained as the deterministic witness.
